description: From PR #106 gating audit (pre-existing): in sharded-resolver mode, abort sets are per-resolver at accumulation time — a transaction aborted by only ONE shard's resolver still has its metadata accumulated by the OTHER resolvers, so metadata from globally-aborted transactions can be distributed to proxies. Harmless for today's recovery-time-only metadata (single system transaction), but MUST be resolved before sharded resolvers carry shard-map traffic (q67.9): either post-merge abort reconciliation before accumulation, or accumulate tentatively and confirm on the global abort-set merge. Marked blocking q67.9; descope only if q67.9 explicitly documents single-resolver-only shard-map support.

comments.text: Implemented on branch feature/q67-sharded-abort-metadata; draft PR #112 into feature/q67-phase-a (commit 13f25e72). Design: deferred accumulation via next-call piggyback — sharded proxies withhold metadata_per_tx, send metadata_hold + globally-filtered metadata_confirms; resolver windows capped at oldest held version; unconfirmed holds expire into a coverage gap (recovery) instead of silent loss. Single-resolver path unchanged. Full suite green at 2 seeds; credo/dialyzer clean. Leaving ticket open pending PR review/merge.

title: Sharded resolvers accumulate metadata from globally-aborted transactions
